nigeria_note: Nigeria parallel ranges combine two independent current-day observations dated 11 Nov, updated at 09:17 and 11:06 WAT and rechecked at 13:30 WAT. The published extrema preserve cross-source differences rather than force a single quote. CBN selling benchmarks are dated 10 Nov, the latest fully published central-bank table. Aggregated from multiple independent market sources.
